title: Publish outcomes
description: What publish --apply did with each action of the plan of one change request, written as soon as each outcome is known. A later --apply skips the actions that have a final outcome and tries the others again.

cr.description: Change request the plan writes to.

planSha256.description: SHA-256 of the plan these outcomes are for; outcomes of another plan are stale and ignored.

blocked.description: Why nothing was written for the change request, when its head changed, it is closed or merged, or it is the account's own.

outcomes.description: One outcome per action that was tried, in the order it was tried.

id.description: Id of the action in the plan.

status.description: posted: written. posted-unassigned: an issue written without its assignee, who cannot be assigned. already-posted: a trusted fingerprint was already there. rejected, secret-blocked, too-long, not-eligible: not written, and final. head-changed, not-open, own-cr: nothing is written for the change request. failed: the platform or the network failed, and a later apply tries again.

number.description: Number of the issue that was created or updated.

detail.description: What else there is to know, in one line; never a token or a text that matched a secret pattern.

timestamp.description: UTC time in RFC 3339 format, for example 2026-11-02T10:15:00Z.

runId.description: Identifier of a review run, also the name of its work directory.
